description: Source code for Honda Accord engine configuration in a vehicle engine management system, including setup functions for different engine types and trigger configurations.

methods.name: setHondaAccordConfigurationCommon
methods.description: Configures common engine parameters for Honda Accord based on the provided engine parameters.

methods.name: setHondaAccordConfigurationThreeWires
methods.description: Sets engine type to Honda Accord with 3 wires and applies common configuration.

methods.name: setHondaAccordConfigurationDip
methods.description: Sets engine type to Honda Accord with DIP trigger and applies common configuration.

methods.name: setHondaAccordConfiguration1_24
methods.description: Sets engine type to Honda Accord with 1/24 trigger and applies common configuration.

methods.name: setHondaAccordConfiguration1_24_shifted
methods.description: Sets engine type to shifted 1/24 trigger with specific offset and applies common configuration.

methods.name: setHondaCivic4_0_both
methods.description: Configures trigger for Honda Civic with 4 teeth, both edges.

methods.name: setHondaCivic4_0_rise
methods.description: Configures trigger for Honda Civic with 4 teeth, rising edge only.
